--surface.name: Surface
--surface.use: Cards, inputs, nav pill, open accordion

--ink.name: Ink
--ink.use: Body text, headings on light (same value as --deep)

--ink2.name: Ink secondary
--ink2.use: Supporting copy, captions, labels on light

--deep.name: Deep green
--deep.use: Headings, dark buttons (Talk to an expert), active tab fill, dots

--moss / --terra.name: Action green
--moss / --terra.use: Primary buttons (white text), links, eyebrow labels, process section fill, ring progress

--terrah.name: Action green hover
--terrah.use: Hover/pressed for primary buttons and links

--leaf.name: Brand green
--leaf.use: Logo, chart fills, highlights, badges WITH dark text, dots, graphics. Never behind white text

--sage.name: Sage
--sage.use: Tags, chips, selected states, soft panels, ESG assessment panel

--line.name: Line
--line.use: Borders, dividers, empty ring track, disabled confirm button fill

--night / --soil.name: Night
--night / --soil.use: Dark sections (Clients, AI, Events), footer, result card

--night2.name: Night raised
--night2.use: Raised surface on night (cards on dark)

--nightInk2.name: Secondary on night
--nightInk2.use: Muted copy on night, footer body

#A6D97A.name: Light leaf (literal)
#A6D97A.use: Footer column headings, hover on footer links, on-track status fill, active bars on night

#5E9A3A.name: Mid leaf (literal)
#5E9A3A.use: Scope 1 segment on night result card, flow lines on night

--s3.name: Scope 3
--s3.use: Scope 3 in charts, upstream/purchased-goods bars, warning accents (graphics only, 3.18:1 on white)

#FF8A3D.name: Off-track (literal)
#FF8A3D.use: Platform SBTi simulator, off-track status text on night
